source.title: Mathematics, Standard V (Term I, Term II, Term III)
source.edition: Samacheer Kalvi term books of the revised syllabus (introduced 2019-20), annual reprints; selfstudys.com labels them '2020-21' edition; exact 2026 imprint not seen
source.publisher: Tamil Nadu Textbook and Educational Services Corporation
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/tn-g05.json. 19 of 19 chapter titles could not be checked against an official source (marked sourceVerified: false). Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://textbooksonline.tn.nic.in/ https://www.tnschools.gov.in/textbooks https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/class-1-to-3-textbooks-ready-works-for-classes-4-to-12-in-primary-stage https://www.dtnext.in/news/tamilnadu/tamil-nadu-classes-4-12-curriculum-preparation-in-third-phase. Notes: Official sources could not be read: textbooksonline.tn.nic.in and textbookcorp.tn.gov.in refuse the fetch tool (robots.txt); tnschools.gov.in and scert.tnschools.gov.in are JavaScript apps that return no content to the fetch tool; the sandbox shell has no internet access. All chapter information comes from secondary sites, so every chapter is verified:false. For 2026-27, Classes 4-5 still use the existing Samacheer Kalvi term books (the syllabus revision introduced 2019-20). DT Next (7 May 2026) reports that books for Classes 4-12 are being produced 'still following the old syllabus', and that new-curriculum books for those classes are targeted for 2027-28. Expect a full change of this grade's books in 2027-28. Chapter titles are consistent across BrainKart, Shaalaa and selfstudys. They are still verified:false because no official PDF or table of contents could be opened.
